recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No further FHIR-13388 work is needed unless a future final work-group decision changes multi-subject section semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-13388 requested adding support for section authors to Composition.section, with the Jira summary also mentioning section subject; the final resolution was Published/Persuasive with 'Will add.'
initial_application: Historical commit aba97275e731cac9eb991e06e995ba18344ac380 (GF#13388 / svn revision 13101) added Composition.section.author to the Composition spreadsheet. Current source migration preserves Composition.section.author in source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml.
additional_context: The later Published FHIR-15755 issue explicitly records that FHIR-13388 missed section.subject and resolves that concern with Composition.section.focus plus a composition-section-subject extension. Current core source includes section.focus and narrative guidance, and the extension exists in the FHIR Extension Pack. The old cda.profile.xml section.subject entry is commented out in source/fhir.ini and is not the active core resource definition. FHIR-42782 later clarified section.author wording and is audited separately in this result.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Composition StructureDefinition already contains Composition.section.author, and the subject/focus semantics are covered by current section.focus guidance and the external section-subject extension rather than by adding a core section.subject element.
